summary: Computes driver rankings after a race, guarded by the race-over flag at this+0xB150 and the session-type check this+0xB14C == 7. Scores season points for the player (entry at this+44908) and for every active driver entry (active flag at +432, 436-byte stride), then ranks active drivers by comparing their position values (+408) and stores the resulting rank count (player rank to this+0xB108). Sets the race-over flag to 1 on completion.

operations.description: If the race-over flag at this+0xB150 is zero, run the full computation; if it is already set, the function returns immediately.
Score the player entry at this+44908: call FlagsGetter to obtain the scoring flags, then SeasonScoring on the player entry.
Iterate 103 driver entries after the player slot, striding 436 bytes per entry.
For each non-player entry, only score it when its active flag at +432 (field this+0x1B0 within the entry) is non-zero.
For each active driver entry, call FlagsGetter and SeasonScoring to accumulate that driver's season points.
Only compute rankings when the race session value at this+0xB14C equals 7.
For each of the 104 slots (i=0..103) iterate all other slots (j) to count how many active drivers have a strictly larger position value.

Read the current driver's position value at +408 (for the player slot i=0 this is field this+0xB104; for other slots it is 436*i+this-436+408) and compare it against each active competitor's +408 value; increment the rank counter for each active competitor with a larger value.
Write the computed rank count: the player's rank to this+45320 (field this+0xB108) for i=0, and to 436*i+this-24 for other slots.
Set the race-over flag at this+0xB150 to 1 so the computation is not repeated.

unresolved: Field this+0xB11C (listed in the packet) is the player entry's active-flag offset (this+44908+432) but the visible source only reads it indirectly through the +432 selector logic; exact equivalence with field this+0xB104's entry is inferred, not shown as a distinct access.
Ranking semantics depend on the unknown meaning of the position value at +408; larger value being worse (rank count of competitors ahead) is inferred from the comparison direction.
Owner object is unknown; callers treat this as a standings/session object whose layout spans this+0x1B0 to this+0xB150.
